memories.m1: The vehicle requires maintenance because its motor overheats.
memories.m2: Keep authentication credentials out of application logs and source control.
memories.m3: After an interruption, recover unfinished tasks from the durable queue.
memories.m4: Preserve a copy of stored information so it can be recovered after disk failure.
memories.m5: Display captions beneath the speaker in vertical short films.
memories.m6: Obtain human authorization before executing irreversible operations.
memories.m7: The cafe serves coffee and fresh bread every morning.
memories.m8: The telescope reveals distant galaxies in the night sky.
